cards.ex: The polling station is a stone's throw away from my house, so I'll walk.
cards.exUz: Saylov uchastkasi uyimdan juda yaqin masofada, shuning uchun piyoda boraman.
cards.uzDef: Judayam yaqin masofada, qo'l yetadigan joyda degani.

cards.ex: The new government must respect the will of the people.
cards.exUz: Yangi hukumat xalq irodasini hurmat qilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xalqning xohishi, talabi, fikri va qarori.

cards.ex: As president, I understand the buck stops here; I take full responsibility.
cards.exUz: Prezident sifatida, javobgarlik men bilan ekanligini tushunaman; men to'liq javobgarlikni o'z zimmamga olaman.
cards.uzDef: Javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olish, aybni tan olish.

cards.ex: He's expected to toe the party line on this issue, despite his reservations.
cards.exUz: Ushbu masala bo'yicha o'zining e'tirozlariga qaramay, u partiya siyosatini qo'llab-quvvatlashi kutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Partiyaning siyosati yoki qarashlariga qat'iy rioya qilish.

cards.ex: The senator is trying to rally the troops to support the new bill.
cards.exUz: Senator yangi qonun loyihasini qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun odamlarni safarbar qilishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarni bir maqsad yo'lida birlashtirish va ruhlantirish.

cards.ex: We need to ensure a level playing field for all candidates in the election.
cards.exUz: Biz saylovda barcha nomzodlar uchun teng imkoniyatlarni ta'minlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun teng sharoitlar va imkoniyatlar yaratish.

cards.ex: The president used his speech to call for unity after the divisive election.
cards.exUz: Prezident bo'linishlarga sabab bo'lgan saylovdan so'ng nutqida birlikka chaqirdi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha odamlarni birgalikda harakat qilishga undash.

cards.ex: The government is trying to strike a delicate balance between economic growth and environmental protection.
cards.exUz: Hukumat iqtisodiy o'sish va atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish o'rtasida nozik muvozanatni saqlashga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muvozanatni saqlash qiyin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: There's a lot of political maneuvering going on behind the scenes.
cards.exUz: Sahna ortida ko'plab siyosiy manevrlar bo'lib o'tmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun ishlatiladigan siyosiy hiyla-nayranglar.

cards.ex: Politics is often the art of compromise, finding solutions that satisfy most people.
cards.exUz: Siyosat ko'pincha kelishuv san'ati bo'lib, ko'pchilikni qoniqtiradigan yechimlarni topishdan iborat.
cards.uzDef: Har xil fikrlarni birlashtirish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Scandals like this erode public trust in the government.
cards.exUz: Bunga o'xshash janjallar hukumatga bo'lgan xalq ishonchini yo'qotadi.
cards.uzDef: Hukumatga yoki siyosatchilarga bo'lgan ishonchni kamaytirish.

cards.ex: The election results showed just how divided the nation had become.
cards.exUz: Saylov natijalari millatning qanchalik bo'linib ketganini ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy, siyosiy yoki madaniy jihatdan bo'lingan mamlakat.

cards.ex: The investigation revealed a clear abuse of power by several officials.
cards.exUz: Tergov bir nechta mansabdor shaxslar tomonidan hokimiyatni suiiste'mol qilish holatini aniqladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z lavozimini shaxsiy maqsadlarda ishlatish.

cards.ex: Politicians should always serve the public interest, not their own.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchilar har doim o'z manfaatlarini emas, balki jamiyat manfaatlariga xizmat qilishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatning umumiy manfaatlarini himoya qilish.

cards.ex: The Prime Minister won a vote of confidence in Parliament.
cards.exUz: Bosh vazir parlamentda ishonch votumida g'alaba qozondi.
cards.uzDef: Hukumatga bo'lgan ishonchni tasdiqlash uchun ovoz berish.

cards.ex: Their policies are a recipe for disaster; they will ruin the economy.
cards.exUz: Ularning siyosati falokat omili; ular iqtisodiyotni buzadi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The capital city is the center of power in the country.
cards.exUz: Poytaxt shahri mamlakatning hokimiyat markazi hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyat qarorlar qabul qilinadigan joy.

cards.ex: For him, it's a matter of principle; he won't compromise on this issue.
cards.exUz: U uchun bu prinsip masalasi; u bu masala bo'yicha murosaga kelmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qat'iy e'tiqodga asoslangan masala.

cards.ex: There's a lack of political will to address the problem of climate change.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi muammosini hal qilish uchun siyosiy iroda yetishmayapti.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun zarur bo'lgan siyosiy kuch va qat'iyat.

cards.ex: Stone the crows! The government actually listened to our concerns.
cards.exUz: Hayratlanarli! Hukumat bizning xavotirlarimizni tingladi.
cards.uzDef: Hayrat yoki ajablanishni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan ibora.

cards.ex: Change needs to start at the grassroots level, with local communities.
cards.exUz: O'zgarishlar quyi darajada, mahalliy jamiyatlardan boshlanishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy xalq orasida, eng past darajada.

cards.ex: We need politicians who will play by the rules and act ethically.
cards.exUz: Bizga qoidalarga rioya qiladigan va axloqiy harakat qiladigan siyosatchilar kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qonun va qoidalarga muvofiq harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The government is creating a climate of fear to suppress dissent.
cards.exUz: Hukumat norozilikni bostirish uchun qo'rquv muhitini yaratmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hamma joyda qo'rquv hukm surgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The regime is trying to tighten its grip on the media.
cards.exUz: Rejim ommaviy axborot vositalari ustidan nazoratni kuchaytirishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyat yoki nazoratni kuchaytirish.

cards.ex: The budget cuts will affect all departments across the board.
cards.exUz: Byudjet qisqartirishlari barcha bo'limlarga umumiy ta'sir qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun bir xil tarzda qo'llaniladigan.

cards.ex: He was accused of bending the rules to favor his friends.
cards.exUz: U do'stlariga yordam berish uchun qoidalarni buzishda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarni ozgina buzish, chetlab o'tish.

cards.ex: She became a voice for the voiceless, advocating for the marginalized.
cards.exUz: U ovozsizlarning ovoziga aylanib, chetlatilganlarning huquqlarini himoya qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini himoya qila olmaydiganlarning manfaatlarini himoya qiluvchi.

cards.ex: After the election, the new party will be in the driving seat.
cards.exUz: Saylovdan keyin yangi partiya asosiy o'rinda bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni nazorat qiluvchi va boshqaruvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: He's a political heavyweight who could easily win the election.
cards.exUz: U saylovda osonlikcha g'alaba qozonishi mumkin bo'lgan siyosiy arbob.
cards.uzDef: Siyosiy sohada katta ta'sirga ega bo'lgan shaxs.

cards.ex: The government floated a trial balloon about raising taxes.
cards.exUz: Hukumat soliqni oshirish haqida sinov shari uchirdi.
cards.uzDef: Jamoatchilik fikrini sinash uchun chiqarilgan yangilik.
